narrative: 夜店、法医鉴证、一场海报式的梦境：牙齿和棉布变得如放射性物质般发亮，周围环境陷入虚空。魅力光（Glam）是美颜主光。
霓虹实景光（Neon Practicals）是你能看见的、作为招牌的彩色灯管。紫外光则是一盏效果本身就是色板的灯。
用在带紫色渲染的日光外景上，它是错误的工具；如果棉布和牙齿依然保持正常，也是错误的用法。如果白色没有炽亮起来，这盏灯就不是紫外光。
how: 平视高度，35mm焦段，固定机位。画面中出现或暗示出一盏黑光灯，作为唯一的主光。
荧光般的白色、通宁水般的紫色，脸上的牙齿和棉布炽亮发光。周围陷入虚空。
不要出现霓虹招牌文字。Prompt: Ultraviolet light on [Subject], black-light cinema, whites that scream, colors that only exist under that lamp.
when: 一家夜店、一张法医鉴证静帧、一场海报式的梦境。不要用日光加紫色渲染来蒙混过关。
vs: 魅力光是美颜主光和眼神光反射点。霓虹实景光是可见的彩色灯管。
紫外光则是一盏黑光灯源，其荧光效果本身就是画面。如果棉布没有炽亮发光，你得到的只是一个紫色调，而不是紫外光。
examples_film: 夜店题材影片和法医鉴证的黑光静帧是最广为人知的应用：那盏灯就是作者。类似《春假甜心》（Spring Breakers）中的派对黑光场景，如果你明确指定了灯管，也可以共享这种荧光效果。
不是一个紫色LUT。也不是要照搬的某个片名。
mistakes: 一个紫色LUT，或霓虹实景光式的招牌。破绽是正常的牙齿和棉布。
修正方法：黑光灯源、荧光般的白色，以及身体周围的虚空。

faq.q: 电影中的紫外光风（Ultraviolet）是什么？
faq.a: 一种基于灯具设备的风格：黑光电影、炽亮尖叫般的白色，只在那盏灯下才存在的颜色。不是日光上的一个紫色调。

faq.q: 紫外光风（Ultraviolet）与霓虹实景光（Neon Practicals）的区别
faq.a: 霓虹实景光是场景中可见的彩色灯管。紫外光则是一盏黑光灯，其荧光效果本身就是色板。如果你能读出霓虹文字，你想要的是霓虹。如果牙齿在虚空中炽亮，你想要的是紫外光。

faq.q: 什么时候该用紫外光风？
faq.a: 夜店、法医鉴证、海报式的梦境。跳过带紫色渲染的日光外景。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写紫外光风的提示词？
faq.a: 先说明一盏黑光灯源，然后要求棉布和牙齿炽亮发光。禁止使用日光紫色LUT。

narrative: Clubs, forensics, a dream of a poster: teeth and cotton go radioactive, surroundings fall toward void. Glam is beauty key.
Neon practicals are colored tubes you can see as signage. UV is a lamp whose effect is the palette.
It is the wrong tool on a daylight exterior with a purple wash, and the wrong tool if cotton and teeth stay normal. If the whites are not blazing, the lamp is not UV.
how: Eye height, 35mm, lock-off. A black-light source in frame or implied as the only key.
Fluorescent whites, tonic violets, face with teeth and cotton blazing. Surroundings void.
No neon-sign letters. Prompt: Ultraviolet light on [Subject], black-light cinema, whites that scream, colors that only exist under that lamp.
when: A club, a forensic still, a poster dream. Do not fake it with a purple wash on daylight.
vs: Glam is beauty key and catchlights. Neon Practicals is visible colored tubes.
Ultraviolet is a black-light source whose fluorescence is the image. If cotton does not blaze, you have a purple grade, not UV.
examples_film: Club cinema and forensic blacklight stills are the well-known uses: the lamp is the author. Spring Breakers -adjacent party blacks can share the fluorescence if you specify the tube.
Not a purple LUT. Not a title to copy.
mistakes: A purple LUT, or Neon Practicals signage. The tell is normal teeth and cotton.
Fix it: black-light source, fluorescent whites, void around the body.

faq.a: A lighting-device look: black-light cinema, whites that scream, colors that only exist under that lamp. Not a purple grade on daylight.

Neon practicals are visible colored tubes in the set. Ultraviolet is a black light whose fluorescence is the palette. If you can read a neon word, you wanted neon. If teeth blaze in a void, you wanted UV.
Clubs, forensics, poster dreams. Skip daylight exteriors with a purple wash.

faq.q: How do I prompt Ultraviolet for AI image or video?
faq.a: Name a black-light source, then: Ultraviolet light on [Subject], black-light cinema, whites that scream, colors that only exist under that lamp. Demand blazing cotton and teeth. Forbid a purple daylight LUT.
